voice.name: WTPN Eleanor - elderly English
voice.note: older British female; Shirley speaks in her eighties, as in the 2021 BBC interviews

segments.b_open: I was six inches above my bed. Rigid — like a board. [pause] My father stood in that room and watched it happen. I was fifteen.
segments.b_s1: It started small. A little silver key, just... sitting on my pillow. Dad tried it in every lock in the house. It fitted none of them. He left it on the kitchen table. [pause] Next morning it was back on my pillow. He thought I was playing a trick on him. I thought he was playing one on me.
segments.b_s2: Everyone heard it. So loud you could hear it from the street. The police came — surveyors, tapping the pipes. Grown men, in their good coats. [soft laugh] Nobody ever found anything.
segments.b_s3: The bedclothes went. Not — not slipping, the way a blanket slips. Pulled. From under me, hard, like something had hold of them. Mum and Dad grabbed the ends, and they could feel it pulling back. And then I was up. [pause] Rigid, about six inches off the bed — that's my father's word, to the papers. I remember the ceiling. I remember I couldn't turn my head. And then it set me down. Gently. Like it was being careful with me.
segments.b_s4: It knocked — counts for yes, counts for no — and then the letters started. Handwriting that wasn't mine — they checked. Signed... Donald. [sighs] He told us he was the King of France. It lied, is what I'm telling you — like a person lies. And it followed me to work. I lost the job. Then my friends.
segments.b_s5: I'm in my eighties now. People have had a lifetime to tell me what it really was. Nerves. A trick. A girl who wanted attention. [soft laugh] I promise you, I wanted anything but. My father was the steadiest man I ever knew. He watched his daughter rise off her bed, and he never took a word of it back. Neither will I. Make of that what you like.

small: The witness was fifteen years old.

big: A reporter slept in Shirley's room.
She watched her pulled from the bed.
She told her story to the BBC

yt_title: Battersea: Six Inches Above the Bed
